metadata.description: Personal plugin marketplace for omp and Codex.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Name branches, write commits, and prepare draft pull requests by repository conventions.

plugins.name: skill-workflow
plugins.description: Create, refine, and independently review focused agent skills, delegating mechanical work to existing tools.

plugins.name: ticket-workflow
plugins.description: Write small, outcome-centered GitHub and Linear tickets while leaving implementation to the assignee.

plugins.name: decision-workflow
plugins.description: Select consequential design decisions and write lightweight ADRs using repository conventions first.

plugins.name: writing-workflow
plugins.description: Write and refine natural Korean, English, and Japanese prose while preserving meaning and author voice.

plugins.name: review-workflow
plugins.description: Evidence-driven code review with independent general and focused reviewers and local-first reporting.

plugins.name: planning-workflow
plugins.description: Plan non-trivial work as a reviewable design, with questions, alternatives, verification, and approval before implementation.
